parameterNotes.sunDistanceFromCentreLy: Rounded 8.2 kpc convention; GRAVITY 2019 measures 8178 +/- 13 statistical +/- 22 systematic pc. https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.05721
parameterNotes.disk: 112000 ly diameter is a display convention, not a sharp observed edge. Scale length and vertical populations informed by https://arxiv.org/abs/1602.07702 ; adopted sampling scales are illustrative.
parameterNotes.bar: 30000 ly full length and 30 degree angle approximate the 4.6-5.0 kpc half length and 28-33 degree angle of https://arxiv.org/abs/1504.01401
parameterNotes.warp: Phenomenological outer warp, not a fit: https://arxiv.org/abs/1902.00998 . Adopted amplitude, onset and phase are visualization choices.
parameterNotes.arms: Illustrative multiarm centre lines, widths and gaps informed by ESA/Gaia/DPAC 2025 and https://arxiv.org/abs/1910.03357 ; not a published coefficient fit. Major/secondary are display weights, not a unique arm taxonomy.
parameterNotes.orion: Local curve passes through adopted Sun location. Its connection to Sagittarius is an illustrative hypothesis, not a confirmed junction.
parameterNotes.bulgeAndHalo: Synthetic ellipsoid and sparse halo informed by https://arxiv.org/abs/1602.07702 ; dimensions and particle weights are display choices, not stellar mass fractions.
parameterNotes.appearance: Colours, extinction strength, particle counts and glow are artistic transfer functions, not calibrated photometry. No ESA image pixels are embedded.

description: Observation-informed educational density model using ESA Gaia's 2025 face-on and edge-on artist impressions as its primary visual reference. Arm centre lines remain an approximation because much of the far side is obscured.
